method: Visual reading of rendered scanned signed letter; these pages lack machine-readable text
women_rule: Nine women-reserved wards determined through draw of lots; wards previously reserved for women excluded from the next draw until all 26 wards have been reserved in rotation.
caste_rule: Five SC wards selected by highest 2001 Census SC population percentage; next five by next-highest percentage at the following election, continuing rotation.
sc_women_rule: Women among the five SC wards determined by public draw of lots.
limits: Letter prescribes the mechanism and the 2011 order confirms its draw; retained evidence does not contain ballot-level records or detailed ordering/rejection protocol for interacting draws.
